sessions.phase_label: Video brief, translation agreement, and contract setup
Initial delivery, review, and revision instructions

requirements.title: UGC Video Production
requirements.definition: Produce a UGC-style video featuring the freelancer as the on-camera performer.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers existence of the requested UGC video deliverable only; language, script adherence, performance directions, setting, duration, and delivery criteria remain independently testable Requirements.

requirements.title: Arabic MSA Language
requirements.definition: Present the video's spoken content in Modern Standard Arabic, translating the supplied source script as needed.
requirements.boundary_note: Translation is treated as the means of producing the requested Arabic MSA performance rather than as a separately delivered translation artifact; completeness against the script is independently evaluated under script adherence.

requirements.title: Strict Script Phrase Adherence
requirements.definition: Perform the supplied script closely and include every required phrase in the recorded video.
requirements.boundary_note: Script completeness can fail and require a reshoot even when the video uses Arabic MSA, so it remains separate from the language Requirement.

requirements.title: Opening Phone-Reading Action
requirements.definition: At the beginning of the video, appear to read the presented question from the phone.
requirements.boundary_note: The opening reading action has its own timing and acceptance criterion and can be corrected independently of screen tapping or spoken-content adherence.

requirements.title: Confident and Timed Screen Taps
requirements.definition: Tap the phone screen confidently and at the appropriate moments during the performance.
requirements.boundary_note: Tap confidence and timing are independently observable performance criteria rather than attributes of the separate opening phone-reading action.

requirements.title: Home Interior Setting
requirements.definition: Film the video in a home-like atmosphere with a room interior visible in the background.
requirements.boundary_note: The home atmosphere and visible room interior form one visual-setting mechanism; sitting on a couch is an implementation approach rather than a separate client Requirement.

requirements.title: Video Duration
requirements.definition: Make the revised video longer than the initial short version if needed while keeping its total duration below one minute.
requirements.boundary_note: Duration has an independent measurable acceptance criterion and can be changed without altering script, language, performance, or setting requirements.

requirements.title: Video Delivery Channel
requirements.definition: Deliver the completed video by posting the video file or its Google Drive link in the project chat.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers where and how the video is sent; whether a posted link can actually be opened is independently testable under delivery-link accessibility.

requirements.title: Delivery Link Accessibility
requirements.definition: Ensure that any video-delivery link is functional and viewable by the client without restricted access.
requirements.boundary_note: Link permissions can fail or be fixed without changing the selected delivery channel, giving accessibility its own failure and verification trajectory.

unresolved_candidates.description: The external Google Drive brief may contain additional video specifications, but its contents are not present in the supplied message evidence and cannot be safely converted into Requirement Atoms.
